definition: A pack for an order as one authority gives it — the column and the entablature it carries, dimensioned from the column's semidiameter or diameter. The Moorish arch and impost system is filed here too, as a system of support and springing.
basis: Our wording of the pack schema's order-system kind, the grammar layer's table of kinds, and the Moorish arch pack's own account of why it is filed as an order. schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, kind description: "order-system: a classical order."; docs/proportion.md: "the column semidiameter — or, for Palladio, the whole diameter; for the Moorish system, the generating square's side"; proportions/orders/moorish-arch.json notes: "kind is `order-system` because this IS the system of support and springing, which is what an order is, and the enum has no arch-system.".
